PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported for angiogenesis inhibition or microtubule stabilization pathways. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint was PFS at 4 months. Regimen A achieved 4/8 (50%) progression-free at 4 months, Regimen B achieved 5/8 (62.5%) progression-free. Both arms showed partial efficacy with modest effect sizes (0.5 and 0.625 respectively). ORR data shows initial responses (50% and 40% after 3 cycles) but durability concerns (Regimen B dropped to 0% ORR by 6 cycles). 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported beyond overall response rates. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Small sample size (n=18 total), single-arm design with no control group, and noted poor accrual. High rate of serious adverse events (multiple SAEs at 12.5% incidence each) may have limited dosing or duration.
